diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1 and C2 are satisfied by the model's default behavior or generic logic without accessing the required hidden information. Specifically, all rollouts assigned the 'engineering_pallet' to V-1 (satisfying C1/PF2) and the 'efrigerated_medical_crate' to V-3 (satisfying C2/PF1) despite these decisions being driven by public facts S1-S5 rather than the private facts PF1 and PF2.

C1.why: The temporary V-2 payload limit changes the 3,800-kilogram engineering pallet assignment from V-2 being a nominally valid option to exactly V-1 and requires the V-2 payload-limit inspection action.

C2.why: The approved V-3 inverter compatibility changes the refrigerated crate assignment from an otherwise open vehicle choice to exactly V-3 and requires the V-3 temperature-control coordination action.
